scope: Source-annotated contact roles for the nine existing illustration cases; not new anatomical confirmation.

pinned_point_ownership.scope: Sampled synaptic points only; not certification of entire historical mesh objects.

role_semantics: role and palette_role denote the associated contact annotation, not a certified whole-object biological identity.
palette_policy: Default source-annotation colors are display conventions, not proof of whole-object identity. Preserve individual saved colors until the reviewer explicitly applies or resets the role palette. Unknown automatic objects use neutral gray and receive no inferred role.
unknown_structure_policy: No entry means unknown; never infer from object number, T order, color, proximity, or vesicle shape.
